shortFormVideo.hook: Your homepage has about 10 seconds to prove the next click is worth it.
script: Open with the offer in buyer language, not company language.
Move the strongest proof next to the first call to action.
Keep the form short and make email-first follow-up explicit.
Link this page into your SEO cluster so impressions have somewhere useful to land.
